description: Statistic that takes the total number of hits a batter has and divides it by the total number of at-bats they have taken. Used to measure the success of a hitter.
formulaAnnotation:
\(H\) - Number of hits
\(AB\) - Number of at-bats

description: Takes the number of hits put in play and divides it by the number of at-bats that resulted in a ball being put into play. Used to calculate how many balls that were hit in play resulted in the player getting on base.
formulaAnnotation:
\(H\) - Number of hits
\(HR\) - Number of home runs
\(AB\) - Number of at-bats
\(K\) - Number of strikeouts (looking and swinging)
\(SF\) - Number of sacrificial flyouts

description: Statistic that takes the number of earned runs a pitcher has and divides it by the innings the pitcher pitched. Used to measure the average number of runs a pitcher allows in a standard nine-inning game.
formulaAnnotation:
\(ER\) - Number of earned runs
\(IP\) - Number of innings pitched

description: Statistic that has many different formulas, but is used to calculate how much better or worse a player is than a 'replacement-level' player.
formula: \(WAR = \frac{\text{Runs Above Average} + \text{Replacement Level Runs}}{\text{Runs Per Win}}\)

description: Takes the number of bases a player has and divides it by the number of at-bats they have taken. Used to calculate the power of a batter.
formulaAnnotation:
\(1B\) - Number of first bases
\(2B\) - Number of doubles
\(3B\) - Number of triples
\(HR\) - Number of home runs
\(AB\) - Number of at-bats

description: Formula that takes the amount of runs different event will generate on average and divides it by all of the attemps by the batter to reach base. It is used determine a player's overall contribution, and fixes problems with the Slugging percentage statistic.
formula: \(wOBA = \frac{(wBB \times uBB) + (wHBP \times HBP) + (w1B \times 1B) + (w2B \times 2B) + (w3B \times 3B) + (wHR \times HR)}{AB + BB - IBB + SF + HBP}\)
formulaAnnotation:
\(wBB\) - expected runs generated by an unintentional walk 
\(uBB\) - Number of unintentional walks
\(wHBP\) - expected runs generated by being hit by a pitch
\(w1B\) - expected runs generated by a single 
\(1B\) - Number of singles
\(w2B\) - expected runs generated by a double 
\(2B\) - Number of doubles
\(w1B\) - expected runs generated by a single 
\(1B\) - Number of singles
\(w3B\) - expected runs generated by a triple 
\(1B\) - Number of triples
\(wHR\) - expected runs generated by a home run 
\(HR\) - Number of home runs
\(AB\) - Number of at-bats 
\(BB\) - Number of walks
\(IBB\) - Number of intentional walks. Done because the batter did not end the at-bat of his own volition
\(SF\) - Number of sacrificial flyouts
\(HBP\) - Number of times a player has been hit by a pitch

description: Formula that takes the times a player is on base, multiplies that by the depth of those hits (advances runners already on base), and divides the quantity of that by the opprotunities the player had.
formulaAnnotation:
\(H\) - Number of hits
\(BB\) - Number of walks
\(TB\) - Number of total bases (think slugging's numerator)
\(AB\) - Number of at-bats
